posts.title: The (Magnificent) Seven Ancient Buddhas
posts.description: Buddhism began in India about 2,500 years ago. It was started by a person who Buddhists call “Gautama Buddha” or “Sakyamuni Buddha”. It's said that Gautama Buddha was enlightened when he was doing meditation early one morning while sitting under a tree. posts.title: I Can't Go On
